notes: Corrected: Now and therefore were exchanged. Rule 14 rules on this exact pair — וְעַתָּה rendered Now therefore gives Now to עַתָּה, which writes its own lexeme, and therefore to the waw, though the waw's word stands second. The accepted alignment had read the pair by position instead, which rule 14 expressly forbids.

The rest of the verse is unchanged: both לְ prepositions are unrepresented under rule 40 because the ASV writes bare English objects, and לְשֵׁם תִּפְאַרְתֶּךָ is rendered attributively under rule 28.
